'''2014 Worlds Day 3 Greg Shaw LS It Is The Future You See''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 3).

2013 Players Committee sheet. No Objective on the sheet; line 1 is Tatooine: Slave Quarters and line 2 is It Is The Future You See (V). Ditto marks expanded. (V) follows the sheet checkbox.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|It Is The Future You See (V) (Virtual Block 2)|VB2-L-itisthefutureyousee-pre.gif|label=It Is The Future You See (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
